title: Dropbox plans to cut ~6% of its staff, or ~200 jobs, costing $27M to $33M in severance and related costs, and says CTO Ali Dasdan will step down on November 18 (Anhata Rooprai/Reuters)
summary: Anhata Rooprai / Reuters: Dropbox plans to cut ~6% of its staff, or ~200 jobs, costing $27M to $33M in severance and related costs, and says CTO Ali Dasdan will step down on November 18 — File hosting service Dropbox (DBX.O) said on Wednesday it would cut its global workforce by about 9% to align investments …
